//: Only what depends on this package's paths. Everything Next.js needs — ESM, the bundler resolver, the automatic JSX runtime, the DOM globals and the `next` language service plugin — is in the shared preset, and every strict flag comes from the base through it.
//paths: `@/*` is the alias of create-next-app, resolved against this file: in a preset it would point inside packages/config.
//incremental: `next build` writes a lot of type information; without this, `tsc --noEmit` and the editor redo the whole program on every run.
//include: `next-env.d.ts` carries the Next.js globals and `.next/types` the ones it generates per route, and both are outside `src`. `next.config.ts` is in the list because it is TypeScript too and would otherwise only break at `next build`.
